review.sharedPrimitivesNote:
This
  repo layers JSON-like → CRDT → Common, and the shared primitives live in
  `packages/sdk/src/` (`document/crdt/`, `document/json/`, `util/`).

fixer.verifyDescription: lint, the Apache licence-header check, the doc links, the SDK build and every unit suite
fixer.integrationWarning: Do NOT run the integration suites (`pnpm sdk test`, `pnpm prosemirror test`): they need a Yorkie server and MongoDB this job does not stand up
fixer.ciFailureNote: If the failure is in one of them, fix it from the diagnosis and let CI confirm.
fixer.generatedCodeNote: Never hand-edit generated code: packages/sdk/src/api/yorkie/v1/*_pb.ts (from `pnpm sdk build:proto`) or packages/schema/antlr/*.ts (from `pnpm schema build:schema`). The `.proto` files beside the SDK's generated code are copies: their source of truth is the server repository, yorkie-team/yorkie.
fixer.apiChangeNote: If the issue requires an API change, say so on the issue and stop rather than working around it.
fixer.keepReproducerAs: Keep it as `it.fails(...)` with a comment naming the finding
fixer.commitNote: Commit messages follow this repository's convention: subject <= 70 characters, a blank line, body wrapped at 80.
fixer.licenceScope: Apache 2.0 licence header on every new source file under packages/*/src, packages/*/test and scripts/ (`pnpm verify:license` checks it).
fixer.todoTrackingLine: Its second line is exactly `Tracked as #__ISSUE_NUMBER__` — that wording, unbolded, is what `scripts/tasks-check.mjs --remote` asks GitHub about, and a todo without it is never checked at all.
fixer.implementVerifyStep: VERIFY WITH `pnpm verify:fast` (lint, licence headers, doc links, the SDK build and every unit suite; no server needed), in the foreground, before the final push. Do NOT run the integration suites (`pnpm sdk test`, `pnpm prosemirror test`): they need a Yorkie server and MongoDB this run does not stand up. A TARGETED unit file (`pnpm sdk exec vitest run test/unit/<file>`) is fine. The PR's CI runs the full lanes, integration included.
fixer.replyVerifyInstruction: run `pnpm verify:fast` (never the integration suites, which need a server this run does not have)
fixer.toolchainSteps: the pnpm setup, the dependency install
fixer.lastResortDiagnosis: Re-run the gate locally: `pnpm verify:fast` (lint, licence headers, doc links, the SDK build and the unit suites).
